verdict.rationale: The Marketing API docs confirm audience/contact creation via API (mailchimp-docs-4) and a root resource for account data (mailchimp-docs-15), implying the API surface exists for list management, but the evidence pack never documents segment or tag creation/update endpoints or an endpoint to read back exact segment/tag membership. missing for 10: explicit segment CRUD docs, tag assignment/read endpoints, membership read-back examples, independent developer corroboration.
